title: 197 · Étude for Falling Bodies collision music machine

scenes.name: Silent stage and six segmented score bars
First amber body launches toward marimba
Dminor intro notes and collection buckets
Theme introduces cyan glockenspiel and purplebass
Theme layers accumulate and cymbal crashes
Groove red drums join all three pitched tiers
Lift repeated pulse and resonator glow
Bodies rebound and drain to collection buckets
Final static stage hold until actual source end
